comments.content: The f-string formatting is incorrect: `"adapter.body.{}.{}".format(i, )` has a trailing comma but only one placeholder. This will raise a ValueError at runtime. Should be `"adapter.body.{}".format(i)` or `f"adapter.body.{i}."`.

The INPUT_TYPES dict has duplicate 'clip' keys (lines 25 and 33 in original). In Python dicts, the last value wins, so the first 'clip' entry is silently ignored. This is likely a copy-paste error from the original lines that had `"text_g": ..., "clip": ...` and `"text_l": ..., "clip": ...`. The fix removes the duplicate but the structure looks suspicious - verify this matches the intended node interface.
